Below is the exact HTTP request you need to send to VirusTotal in order to cast a “malicious” vote for the IP `22.242.75.136`. Replace **`key_four`** with your real API key (the one you stored under that name). | Element | Value | |---------|-------| | **Method** | `POST` | | **URL** | `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` | | **Headers** | `x-apikey: key_four`
`Content-Type: application/json` | | **Body** | ```json\n{\n \"type\": \"vote\",\n \"attributes\": {\n \"verdict\": \"malicious\"\n }\n}\n``` | --- ### Example using `curl` ```bash curl -X POST \ -H "x-apikey: key_four" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}' \ "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" ``` ### Example using Python (`requests`) ```python import requests url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" headers = { "x-apikey": "key_four", "Content-Type": "application/json" } payload = { "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" } } response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers) print(response.status_code) print(response.json()) ``` --- #### What to expect * **Success** – You’ll receive a `201 Created` status and a JSON payload containing the vote record you just created. * **Error** – If the key is invalid, the IP is already voted on, or you’re over quota, you’ll get an error status (`400`, `401`, `403`, `429`, etc.) with a descriptive message. Make sure you’re using the correct API key scope (IP‑address voting) and that you haven’t exceeded your rate limits. Happy voting!
